description: Create Scene003_FirstConnection and Scene003Phases, wire it into Engine.js for transition from Scene002, integrate camera attention, audio hooks, environmental ripple, and accessibility (reduced motion). This is the emotional scene orchestration.
steps: Create js/scenes/scene003/Scene003Phases.js - Define the emotional phase timeline for Scene003 (total ~18s). Phase 1 (0-3s): Atmosphere continues from Scene002, environment settles. Phase 2 (3-7s): Discovery - ConnectionManager searches for candidate pair using ConnectionPrediction. Phase 3 (7-11s): Approach - two particles gently drift toward each other, approach force applied. Phase 4 (11-12.5s): The Pause - both particles nearly stop, everything else continues. Phase 5 (12.5-14.5s): The Connection - filament fades in, living line appears. Phase 6 (14.5-17s): Pulse - single pulse travels A to B, ripple affects nearby particles, camera eases toward connection, lighting shifts subtly. Phase 7 (17-18s): Settle - connection remains, scene marks completed. Export SCENE003_DURATION = 18.

Create js/scenes/Scene003_FirstConnection.js following the exact pattern of Scene002_Awakening.js. It should: use SCENE_ID 'scene003_firstConnection', store universe reference, initialize ConnectionManager + BehaviorSystem + ConnectionPrediction + SceneDirector subsystems on enter(), activate environment (fog, gradients, vignette, cameraDrift, dark theme). In update(): advance director, update ConnectionManager, handle camera attention (use CameraController.setTarget toward connected pair midpoint when connected), handle environmental ripple (subtle force on nearby particles when connection forms). Register audio events via AudioArchitecture: connection_discovered, connection_created, pulse_started, pulse_finished, connection_broken. Never emit audio (still muted). On leave(): restore everything, destroy subsystems.

Add Scene003 rendering integration: In Scene003's enter(), register a CONSTELLATIONS layer renderer on BackgroundRenderer that calls ConnectionManager.render(ctx). This renders the filament and pulse on top of particles but below fog/overlays. Use UNIVERSE_LAYERS.CONSTELLATIONS layer which exists but is inactive.

Wire Engine.js to support Scene002 -> Scene003 transition: Import Scene003_FirstConnection. Add initScene003() method that registers the scene. Add scene002Duration/scene002Elapsed tracking. In checkSceneTransition(), after Scene002 is active and scene002.isCompleted() returns true, transition to Scene003. Follow the same pattern as Scene001 -> Scene002 transition.

Implement the environmental ripple in Scene003: When ConnectionManager transitions to CONNECTED state, apply a one-time subtle radial force (strength from settings.scene003.rippleStrength) to particles within settings.scene003.rippleRadius of the connection midpoint. The force pushes particles gently outward - like a breath, not an explosion.

Implement camera attention: When connection enters CONNECTED state, calculate midpoint of the two connected particles and call CameraController.setTarget(midpointX - canvasWidth/2, midpointY - canvasHeight/2) scaled to the camera's bias range (very subtle, similar to cluster bias). In reduced motion mode, reduce camera movement by 80%.

Implement reduced motion accessibility: In ConnectionRenderer, if reducedMotion is true, line appears instantly at max opacity without breathing. In PulseRenderer, pulse becomes an opacity swell at midpoint rather than traveling. Camera movement reduced. Connection still happens - just without animation.
acceptance_criteria: Engine.js passes node --check with new Scene003 import and transition logic
Scene003 registers audio events but never emits sound (muted)
Exactly one connection is created per scene run
Camera attention is subtle (uses existing setTarget, not a new system)
Environmental ripple is one-time, not looping
Reduced motion mode gracefully degrades all animations
CONSTELLATIONS layer is activated for connection rendering
No class exceeds 400 lines, no function exceeds 60 lines
All imports resolve correctly between files
